Migration complete. The project has been successfully migrated from Pages Router to App Router:

- Created `app/layout.tsx` with root layout containing metadata
- Created `app/page.tsx` with the migrated home page (using Next.js 15 App Router patterns)
- Removed the `pages` directory

- `metadata` API instead of `next/head`
- Server Components by default
- Root layout replaces both `_app.tsx` and `_document.tsx`

The project builds successfully with static page generation working correctly.
